description: A Vue.js composable function for managing timesheet operations in the OrangeHRM system, including loading, editing, submitting, approving, rejecting, and creating timesheets, with related UI state management and navigation.

methods.name: loadTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches and loads timesheet data and entries for a given date and employee number, updating the component state accordingly.

methods.name: onClickPrevious
methods.description: Sets the date to one week earlier and reloads the timesheet.

methods.name: onClickNext
methods.description: Sets the date to one week later and reloads the timesheet.

methods.name: onClickEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the timesheet editing page for the current timesheet.

methods.name: onClickSubmit
methods.description: Submits the current timesheet and reloads data upon success.

methods.name: onClickReset
methods.description: Resets the current timesheet and reloads data upon success.

methods.name: onClickApprove
methods.description: Approves the current timesheet with optional comment and reloads data upon success.

methods.name: onClickReject
methods.description: Rejects the current timesheet with optional comment and reloads data upon success.

methods.name: onClickCreateTimesheet
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for the current date.
